IMP-001External

Product discovery and target-operating-model assessment

Core · Experience & Adoption · Owner: Customer Experience & Implementation

Acceptance boundary

Institution-owned evidence must demonstrate product discovery and target-operating-model assessment before production acceptance.

Current maturity and gap

Delivery is institution- or partner-owned; LoanOS can retain resulting approvals and evidence but cannot complete the external activity.

Dependencies

Approved tenant configuration Institution operating model

Review currency

    Sanitized checksum-sealed receipt from the passed 12-step in-app browser run; explicitly synthetic and non-production.
